verified_from_source_and_guards: Opening answer requires the unpredictable page code and the ordered public workflow stages.
A second question is sent before panel reload, on the same fixture tab, and must produce a later assistant reply containing the separate follow-up code and fixture heading.

The post-reload question and grounded answer remain required; final transport proof requires exactly one HTTP 200 offscreen POST for each of opening, same-conversation follow-up, and post-reload turns.
The observer requires opening is_new=true, same-turn is_new=false with an identical conversation fingerprint, and post-reload is_new=true with a different fingerprint.
